title: PR #12946 @ a390b5d5 (= e3ecba66 production code) — Hosted MCP happy path, real stack
subtitle: Packaged Harness (dist/cli.js) -> embedded Java Broker (Spring jar) -> provisioned Runtime worker -> real MCP servers. Only the model is a fixture. MySQL 8.4.11 and MariaDB 10.11.18.
lines: ## Transports: stdio (child of the Runtime worker), Streamable HTTP :18811 (Bearer), SSE :18812 (Bearer)
++ RUN_MCP turn: 3 tool calls -> ledger: stdio-0:effect:t-stdio | http:effect:t-http | sse:effect:t-sse   (exactly 3 effects)
++ checkpoint phase observed at the 2nd model request: results_ready   (2 model requests, turn_complete end_turn)
++ resource_read mem://blob via HTTP: 300 bytes, base64 identical      prompt_get 'two' via SSE: user:FIRST:sse, assistant:SECOND:sse
++ same operationId again -> identical response; reuse with other uri -> 503; reuse on other server -> 503; 0 extra effects
++ private + public catalog: 3 servers x (5 tools, 3 resources, 1 prompt); secret-token/Bearer/URL/command/env: 0 hits
++ detach: 3 x mcp-release + tool-session release -> 204; records: 3 mcp_configuration + 3 mcp_operation, task_kind NULL
++ public /tasks list: empty (MCP records are not Session tasks)
++ load -> new owner mcp:<sid>:<digest>, fresh configure, tool call OK; replay of the committed prompt result: identical
== total physical effects 8 = 3 tools + 1 whoami + 3 operations + 1 after load; MariaDB run: identical numbers
## Author's recovery claims, re-run independently (MySQL 8.4.11)
++ configure reply AND invoke reply dropped by a proxy -> mcp-status on original ids -> settled, exactly 1 physical read
++ Workspace can_read=FALSE, then close -> 204, lease released; new work after revocation -> Broker acquire 409 (refused)
++ reload + Broker returning 503 for everything: committed replay 202 (2 messages), close 204, 0 Broker requests, 0 effects
++ replace local r1 -> r2 while a 6 s call runs on r1: 202; call finished on stdio-2 (r1); next turn advertised and used stdio-2-r2
++ limits: 65-tool server -> 33 advertised, tools 'partial' (16 KiB); 70 KB result -> managed_mcp_output_limit, Session healthy

notes.text: SSE was only unit-covered by the author; here it runs through the full SQL stack. The durability contract (intent before effect, results_ready before the next inference, replay without reconnecting, original-id recovery) holds on both engines.

title: F1 — an attached MCP Session holds the Workspace execution lease between turns
subtitle: Three Sessions in one Workspace (storage-1): A and B use hosted-workspace-mcp/1, C uses hosted-workspace-files/1. Same result on MySQL and MariaDB.
lines: ## step                                    lease holder (managed_workspace_execution_lease)   outcome
++ A prompt (MCP tool)                     mcp:<A>                                            turn_complete
++ A prompt (write_file, same Session)     mcp:<A>                                            turn_complete, file written
-- B prompt (MCP), A idle but attached     mcp:<A>                                            HTTP 503 hosted_prompt_admission_failed (acquire 409)
-- C prompt (files), A idle but attached   mcp:<A>                                            turn_error 'Hosted Harness turn failed', no file
== A detach                                (none)                                             204
++ B prompt (MCP)                          mcp:<B>                                            turn_complete
-- C prompt (files), B idle but attached   mcp:<B>                                            turn_error
== B detach
++ C prompt (files)                        (per-turn)                                         turn_complete
== cause: HostedWorkspaceToolTurn skips broker.release() for the MCP profile; HostedMcpSession releases only in close()

notes.text: While any MCP Session is attached, every other Session in its Workspace is tool-less. Combined with F3/F4/F5 below, one stuck MCP Session locks the Workspace indefinitely.

title: F3/F4 — cancel or a >25 s MCP call leaves the Session and its Workspace stuck
subtitle: Servers are @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.30.0 McpServer; per the MCP spec it never answers a request it was told to cancel.
lines: ## case                                server ledger             state after             prompt  detach  lease  other Session
-- cancel resource_read (HTTP, MySQL)  start 4.2s aborted 5.4s   outcome_unknown +12s    409     503     held   503
-- cancel resource_read (SSE, MariaDB) start 5.1s aborted 6.6s   outcome_unknown +12s    409     503     held   503
-- prompt cancel during MCP tool       start 9.1s aborted 10.6s  no terminal event       409     503     held   503
-- MCP tool of 32 s (no cancel)        start 9.1s done 41.1s     unknown at 25 s         409     503     held   503
## why the 32 s case never heals although the server answered
== Runtime: late response settles its own view (pending cleared)
-- Broker: qwen_tool_execution.execution_state = UNKNOWN (dispatch_generation 1), never re-queried
-- detach: mcp-release 200 -> tool-sessions/mcp:<sid>:release 409 -> Harness 503 managed_session_close_failed
== Hosted MCP timeout: hard-coded TIMEOUT_MS = 25_000, manifest rejects a timeout field
== ordinary MCP (core mcp-client.ts): MCP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MSEC = 10 min, configurable per server

notes.text: Cancel is an ordinary user action and 25 s is short for MCP tools. Each path ends in a Session that can be neither prompted nor closed, and (F1) a Workspace no other Session can use.

title: F2/F5/F6/F7 — connection lifecycle after the first successful turn
subtitle: Single Session per case on MySQL 8.4.11; F2 (resources) and F5 re-run on MariaDB 10.11.18 with the same outcome. Effects counted from the MCP server ledger.
lines: ## F2  server sends notifications/<kind>/list_changed; the Harness never dispatches mcp-discover
-- kind=resources: next tool call same turn -> managed_mcp_catalog_conflict; next turn -> same; prompt_get -> same; 0 effects
-- kind=tools:     identical; Harness /mcp-catalog still reports catalogRevision 1, tools/resources/prompts 'complete'
-- SSE server restarted mid-Session -> next call managed_mcp_catalog_conflict, 0 effects (connection retired on onerror)
++ only recovery: POST /mcp/configurations {expectedRevision: 1} -> 202, then calls work again
## F5  Streamable HTTP server down when the Session closes
-- detach -> 503 within 1 s (678 ms MySQL, 228 ms MariaDB); code path: terminateSession DELETE throws -> drain_unknown
-- server back up, detach again -> 503 (release op still not settled); config releaseState releasing, lease held
## F6  each reconfiguration keeps the previous connection open
!! rev:status:live stdio processes  2:202:2  3:202:3 ... 16:202:16  17:409:16  (one server, one Session)
== detach reaps all 16 (6.9 s); until then the per-Runtime quota of 16 is consumed by retired connections
## F7  first install refused (Workspace busy) leaves an undispatched configuration intent
-- status recoveryBlocked:true; detach 503 while A holds the Workspace and still 503 after A leaves
++ a later prompt dispatches the intent; only then detach -> 204

notes.text: F5: a transient remote outage at close leaves a Session that retrying does not clear. F2 + F6: the documented recovery path (reconfigure) succeeds 15 times per Session, then the connection quota refuses it.
